faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Para Pump Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Para Pump Operator recruitment is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Para Pump Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for the Para Pump Operator post in the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Para Pump Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Matriculation (10th) with an ITI certificate in Electrician, Wireman, Diesel Mechanic, or Pump Operator-cum-Mechanic, or a certificate from a Skill Development Scheme.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Para Pump Operator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 7100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What are the selection criteria for the Para Pump Operator role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Scrutiny, a Skill Test, and a Physical Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag: https://jsv.hp.nic.in.
